convention.binary_collapse_disclosure: If a caller collapses three verdicts into PASS/FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE must be reported as FAIL, never as PASS. Collapsing INCONCLUSIVE into PASS reproduces the failure mode documented in arXiv 2604.17125, where the same gate reported 11.70% or 1.51% false positives depending purely on the convention.

assured.statement: Canonical bytes hash to the digest the manifest claims
The seal verifies against the stated Ed25519 key
The evidence set is complete relative to the declared index
The lifecycle sequence is monotone and correctly ordered
Declared identities and scalars are internally consistent
The package is byte-identical to an earlier acceptance, when a head is pinned

not_assured: That the content is true (integrity is not authenticity)
That a witness saw it (no timestamp anchoring required to PASS)
That the signing event was authorized (signature validity is not authority)
That nothing was omitted (completeness is checked against a declared index, not reality)
That no out-of-band execution occurred (no runtime observation)
That revocation and expiry were considered (not reachable from verify in the current implementation)
That the judge is independent (a verdict is a machine output; who ran it is a separate fact)
